mapper.select: select id, uid, balance, frozen, total_earned, total_withdrawn, create_time, update_time from user_wallet where uid = #{uid}
select id, uid, balance, frozen, total_earned, total_withdrawn, create_time, update_time from user_wallet where uid = #{uid} for update
mapper.insert: insert into user_wallet (uid, balance, frozen, total_earned, total_withdrawn) values (#{uid}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{totalEarned}, #{totalWithdrawn})

insert into wallet_withdraw (uid, amount, status, remark, wx_transfer_no, out_batch_no, out_detail_no, wx_detail_no, fail_type, user_message) values (#{uid}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{wxTransferNo}, #{outBatchNo}, #{outDetailNo}, #{wxDetailNo}, #{failType}, #{userMessage})
mapper.select: select id, uid, amount, status, remark, wx_transfer_no, out_batch_no, out_detail_no, wx_detail_no, fail_type, user_message, create_time from wallet_withdraw where uid = #{uid} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 50
select id, uid, amount, status, remark, wx_transfer_no, out_batch_no, out_detail_no, wx_detail_no, fail_type, user_message, create_time from wallet_withdraw where out_batch_no = #{outBatchNo} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into wallet_transaction (id, uid, biz_type, biz_id, direction, amount, balance_after, remark, create_time) values (#{id}, #{uid}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, uid, biz_type, biz_id, direction, amount, balance_after, remark, create_time from wallet_transaction where uid = #{uid} order by create_time desc, id desc limit 100
select count(1) from wallet_withdraw where uid = #{uid} and status = 0

select id, uid, amount, status, remark, wx_transfer_no, out_batch_no, out_detail_no, wx_detail_no, fail_type, user_message, create_time from wallet_withdraw where status = 0 and create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL 3 MINUTE
